name: Janov (Bruntál District, Czechia)
description: Two horizontal stripes of yellow and green in the ratio 3:1, with crossed black miners' hammers in the yellow at the fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 13 February 1996 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
